    Periodic localization for spanning rows #

    prop:periodic-localization (scalar-normalization.tex), as used in Appendix B: "The quotient maps in Proposition 5.1 specify the direct-sum identification." We extend the transfer row_mem_imageD_of_restrict from one row to any family of path combinations on a τ-closed subquiver Q_S (inclRow_mem_imageD): if its classes lie in the image of D_m(C(Q_S)), its inclusion lies in the image of D_m(C(Q)), provided the rows through vertices outside S do. Consequently spanning rows transfer (rowClass_mem_rowSpan_of_restrict).
